阴、柔、静、内敛、滋养、周期、臣辅: Yin, gentleness, stillness, introspection, nourishment, cycles, support
规划、整理、启动、梳理资料: Planning, organizing, getting started, sorting materials
财物、家具、修整、营造、日常事务: Finances, furnishings, repairs, construction, everyday affairs
火、阳动、礼、威势、兵争、变动: Fire, active yang, propriety, power, conflict, change
最难任务、执行、攻坚、运动: Hardest tasks, execution, tackling challenges, exercise
军事、捕盗、田猎、农事、医药: Military affairs, catching thieves, hunting, farming, medicine
水、流动、智慧、法度、谋略、应变: Water, flow, wisdom, rules, strategy, adaptability
入学、学技艺、远行、收债: Starting school, learning skills, travel, collecting debts
木、生长、春、生发、仁德、义、福庆: Wood, growth, spring, emergence, benevolence, righteousness, good fortune
战略、合作、重要决策、资源协调: Strategy, collaboration, major decisions, coordinating resources
求师、论议、谒官、交往、置业: Seeking teachers, discussion, official audiences, social contact, property
Jupiter：权威、扩张、法律、幸运: Jupiter: authority, expansion, law, good fortune
金、刚健、肃杀、兵革、决断、威权: Metal, strength, severity, warfare, decisiveness, authority
见贵人、衣饰、成亲、交友、置宅: Meeting influential people, clothing, marriage, friendship, housing
土、中央、厚重、稳定、承载、信用、守成: Earth, the center, solidity, stability, support, trust, preservation
阳、君、光明、刚健、生机、主导、权威: Yang, rulership, light, strength, vitality, leadership, authority
休息、户外、家庭、复盘、轻规划: Rest, time outdoors, family, reflection, light planning
拜官、远行、行医、入学、祈福: Taking office, travel, medicine, study, seeking blessings
阴极阳生，一阳初生: At the deepest yin, yang begins to emerge
睡觉；最好已进入稳定睡眠，避免继续工作、饮酒或吃夜宵: Sleep; ideally already settled into steady sleep. Avoid further work, alcohol or late-night snacks.
夜深阴盛: Deep night, with yin at its strongest
深度睡眠；尽量不要主动压缩这一时段的睡眠: Deep sleep; avoid deliberately cutting short sleep in this period.
阳气渐生，天将明: Yang gradually rises as dawn approaches
继续睡眠；若必须早起，可做非常轻缓的活动: Continue sleeping. If you must get up early, keep activity very gentle.
起床、排便、散步、晨间拉伸、行走冥想: Get up, use the bathroom, walk, stretch gently or try walking meditation.
阳气旺盛，开始劳作: Yang is strong; daily work begins
早餐、规划一天、开始工作: Have breakfast, plan the day and begin work.
高认知任务：写作、学习、分析、设计、处理困难问题: Demanding mental tasks: writing, learning, analysis, design and difficult problems.
阳气达峰，阴始生: Yang peaks and yin begins to emerge
午餐、散步、短暂休息；适合从高强度工作切换下来: Lunch, a walk and a short rest; ease out of high-intensity work.
午睡后恢复、一般性工作、沟通协作: Ease back in after a nap, routine work, communication and collaboration.
第二工作高峰：复盘、解决问题、重要会议，也适合运动: A second work peak: review, problem-solving, important meetings or exercise.
运动、散步、晚餐、结束一天工作: Exercise, walk, eat dinner and finish the working day.
陪伴家人、阅读、轻学习、洗澡、放松: Spend time with family, read, study lightly, bathe and relax.
阴气渐盛，准备进入子时: Yin strengthens as the Zi period approaches
收尾、冥想、阅读、准备睡觉；降低灯光和屏幕刺激: Wrap up, meditate, read and prepare for sleep; dim lights and reduce screen stimulation.
